messages:
Maya: Heads-up — Atlas Carrier QBR next Wed. Need slide leads, top exec asks, and a clear renewal signal. Who can own what? :spiral_notepad:

Jonah: I can coordinate slide ordering and run pre-read. Can we freeze deck by Mon EOD?

Priya: I'll own renewal health + risks. Will pull seat growth, MRR delta, and last 3 NPS snippets by Friday.

Sam: I'll take onboarding status + blockers. Need Eng to confirm webhook retry and demo dataset fix timelines.

Ken: @Sam Eng will triage webhook retry first — aiming for EOW. Demo dataset mismatch needs product signoff, ETA uncertain.

Claire: I'll draft the exec storyline and a 1-slide ROI highlight (caching savings + latency improvement). Priya, want a single metric callout?

Priya: Yes — please use net reduction in token cost as the headline and attach a small table with sessions impacted.

Maya: Action items: Sam post blockers doc link, Priya supply renewal signal, Claire write exec narrative. Deck freeze Mon EOD.

Sam: Uploaded blockers: https://short.link/atlas-onboard-ops — two items: webhook retry + demo dataset mismatch. Added customer verbatims.

Priya: Renewal status = watchlist (amber). Signals: flat seats + delayed integration. Proposed mitigation: complimentary 2-week enablement + SLA pilot.

Ken: I can back the SLA pilot ask. I'll draft the COA (course of action) and suggested phrasing for the exec ask.

Claire: Slide owners so far: Renewal (Priya), Onboarding (Sam), Exec ROI (Claire), Action tracker (Maya). I'll prep a 400-word narrative for the execs.

Maya: Request: can someone secure 15 minutes with the Atlas COO during the QBR to discuss renewal path? Ken to join for technical assurances.

Ken: I'll join and can speak to the pilot & SLA details.

Jonah: I'll run a pre-read Tue morning and call out any gaps. If you need more time, flag by Mon noon.

qbr-bot: Reminder: QBR dry-run scheduled Tue 10:00am in #customer-success. Calendar invite sent.

Maya: Timeline recap: Today — Sam link posted (done), Priya — renewal signals by Fri, Claire — exec narrative draft by Sun night. Reconvene Mon 9am for a final pass. :thumbsup:
